events.title: Microsoft and OpenAI extend partnership
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: It extends our ongoing collaboration across AI supercomputing and research and enables each of us to independently commercialize the resulting advanced AI technologies.

events.title: Google AI updates: Bard and new AI features in Search
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: We've been working on an experimental conversational AI service, powered by LaMDA, that we're calling Bard.

events.title: Introducing Microsoft 365 Copilot - your copilot for work
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, we are bringing the power of next-generation AI to work.

events.title: Introducing Gemini: Google's most capable AI model yet
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, we're a step closer to this vision as we introduce Gemini, the most capable and general model we've ever built.

events.title: Introducing Gemini 1.5, Google's next-generation AI model
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, we're announcing our next-generation model: Gemini 1.5.

events.title: Introducing Copilot+ PCs
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, at a special event on our new Microsoft campus, we introduced the world to a new category of Windows PCs designed for AI, Copilot+ PCs.

events.title: Google introduces Gemini 2.0: A new AI model for the agentic era
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today we're excited to launch our next era of models built for this new agentic era: introducing Gemini 2.0, our most capable model yet.

events.title: Gemini 2.5 Pro update: Coding, web apps with Gemini
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: This builds on the overwhelmingly positive feedback to Gemini 2.5 Pro's coding and multimodal reasoning capabilities.

events.title: Microsoft Build 2025: The age of AI agents and building the open agentic web
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: We've entered the era of AI agents.

events.title: The next chapter of the Microsoft-OpenAI partnership
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: As we enter the next phase of this partnership, we've signed a new definitive agreement that builds on our foundation, strengthens our partnership, and sets the stage for long-term success for both organizations.

events.title: Gemini 3: Introducing the latest Gemini AI model from Google
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Google introduces Gemini 3, its most intelligent AI model, enhancing reasoning and multimodal capabilities.

events.title: Maia 200: The AI accelerator built for inference
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Maia 200 is also the most efficient inference system Microsoft has ever deployed, with 30% better performance per dollar than the latest generation hardware in our fleet today.

events.title: Gemini 3.5: frontier intelligence with action
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: This represents a major leap forward in building more capable, intelligent agents.

events.title: 100 things we announced at Google I/O 2026
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: We launched Gemini 3.5 Flash: the first in our latest series of models combining frontier intelligence with action.

events.title: Powering the next wave of AI: Expanding capacity with our new datacenter in Pecos
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, Microsoft is announcing one of the largest single capacity additions in our history.

events.title: Microsoft expands Azure AI and HPC infrastructure with AMD
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Building on our close collaboration with AMD, Microsoft is bringing AMD's latest Helios AI platform and next-generation EPYC datacenter processors to Azure.

events.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash: our most intelligent workhorse model
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: Today, we're building on the progress of our widely used Flash series by introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash, our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.

events.title: Gemini 3.8 Live & Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
events.label: Reported
events.evidence_quote: We are launching Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking to make voice interactions more natural, fluid, and intelligent.

event_summary.note: Sự kiện chỉ lấy từ trang chính thức của Google/Microsoft và được kiểm tra trùng nguyên văn câu trích dẫn cùng ngày công bố; đây là kiểm tra bằng chứng tự động, không phải review biên tập của con người.
